label: monode
title: もので
meaning_example: because I have no savings, can you lend me money

examples.body_text:
初心者なもので 

As I'm a 
		newbie ...
examples.body_html:
初心者なもので 
As I'm a newbie ...

examples.japanese: 月謝を払う余裕がないもので、少しお金を貸してくれますか。
examples.body_text:
月謝を払う余裕がないもので、少しお金を貸してくれますか。 

Since 
		I cannot afford to pay my monthly tuition, would you mind lending me some money?
examples.body_html:
月謝を払う余裕がないもので、少しお金を貸してくれますか。 
Since I cannot afford to pay my monthly tuition, would you mind lending me some money?

examples.body_text:
だって、　高いもん〜！ 

But 
		its really expensive!
examples.body_html:
だって、　高いもん〜！ 
But its really expensive!

comments.text: This is often used when saying excuses.  Shortened to もん in spoken Japanese.  I really hate hearing people say this to me.
comments.html: This is often used when saying excuses.  Shortened to もん in spoken Japanese.  I really hate hearing people say this to me.

comments.text: sorry, I often use もん...　だって暑いんだもん。いらいらするんだもん。;)
comments.html: sorry, I often use もん...　だって暑いんだもん。いらいらするんだもん。;)

comments.text: I often hear this in the context of a whiney complaint.  Several Japanese friends advised me that only children and sometimes women use it and that adult males rarely or never use it (depending on the person).
comments.html: I often hear this in the context of a whiney complaint.  Several Japanese friends advised me that only children and sometimes women use it and that adult males rarely or never use it (depending on the person).

comments.text: I would add that 〜もん is not necessarily always in the context of complaining. However, it is VERY cheeky; using this can absolutely project a bad impression, unless you really are among the bold, frank, and sometimes even careless. (For an example of usage among men, see the Japanese language version of Red Dwarf)

sections.text:
もので [もので] (monode)
    Meaning: because of (that thing) 
    Example: because I have no savings, can you lend me money
    JLPT Level: 2
    Category: grammar
    Author: dc
